subject: SOW addendum: onboarding services + capacity change request
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@brightcart.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightCart Procurement <procurement@brightcart.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: onboarding SOW addendum + capacity bump

Jonas —

Thanks again for the demo last week. BrightCart is moving forward with a pilot and we need a short SOW addendum to cover onboarding services (data ingestion + connector work) and a one-time capacity top-up for the first 3 months (approx. 75k tokens/day spike). Can you: 

- Confirm whether Redwood can add an onboarding services SOW as an addendum to our existing MSA and order form
- Provide a proposed fee schedule and timeline for the onboarding work
- Confirm any data handling / retention language we should expect in the SOW to share with our security team

We need a draft this week if possible — our procurement lead is pushing for sign-off before the end of month.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Head of AI Programs | BrightCart
Elaine.Park@brightcart.com

Attachment: BrightCart_SOW_v1.docx (current draft they’d like us to amend)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@brightcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding SOW addendum + capacity bump

Elaine —

Appreciate the quick turnaround here. We can do an onboarding addendum and include a temporary capacity top-up. High level:

- Scope: data ingestion connectors (S3 / GCS), schema mapping, 2 days of runbook handoff, 2 training sessions for BrightCart engineers
- Capacity: 75k tokens/day for first 90 days; propose a one-time setup fee + prorated usage (I attached a proposed fee sheet)
- Data handling: we will surface standard Redwood retention language (30 days KV cache retention by default for onboarding unless you request longer), and we can add a clause about no customer content used for model training unless explicitly agreed

I'll draft redlines against your SOW and loop in Legal for turnaround. Marissa, Rishi — can you review commercial terms; Rishi if Legal needs to adjust retention wording, please advise.

Next steps: I’ll send a marked-up SOW + fee schedule by EOD. If procurement needs a DocuSign flow, we can prepare that after legal clears the SOW.

- Jonas
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189

Attachments: proposed_fee_schedule.xlsx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Legal Team <legal@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@brightcart.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: BrightCart SOW v1 + my redlines — expedited review requested

Team — forwarding BrightCart’s SOW and my redlines (attached PDF). Key asks from procurement that may be out-of-band: 90-day temporary capacity bump, and explicit data retention language for onboarding. Procurement needs the SOW + order form countersigned by end of month.

Please prioritize review:
- Section 2 (scope): accept onboarding tasks, no change needed
- Section 6 (data handling): recommend we keep standard retention and add explicit "no training" language; procurement may push back on retention length
- Section 9 (fees): propose a one-time onboarding fee + prorated usage; see fee sheet attached

If Legal can provide comments inline and a clause for limited onboarding retention, we can send to BrightCart tonight. I’ve attached jonas_redlines_20270315.pdf and the fee schedule.

Thanks — Jonas

Attachments: jonas_redlines_20270315.pdf, proposed_fee_schedule.xlsx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Legal Team <legal@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: BrightCart SOW v1 + my redlines — expedited review requested

Jonas / team —

Thanks for the flags. Quick review notes: 

- Data retention: we should propose two options (default 30 days, optional 90 days for an additional fee). Add explicit sentence: "Redwood will not use Customer Content to train or improve models without Customer's prior written consent."
- Liability: tighten indemnity scope to standard mutual indemnities; do not accept broad service-level indemnities for customer-generated model outputs
- Capacity: treat the 90-day capacity bump as an order form amendment with a defined start/end date and measurable token threshold; attach the prorated fee schedule to the order form
- Signatures: recommend DocuSign and state that countersignature by Redwood is via authorized signer on file

I’ll prepare inline redlines and a short cover email for procurement. Marissa — can you confirm commercial acceptance of the fee numbers in the spreadsheet?

- Rishi
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@brightcart.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightCart Procurement <procurement@brightcart.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOW addendum: onboarding services + capacity change request — draft and next steps

Elaine / team —

Thanks for the patience. Attached is Redwood’s SOW addendum (PDF with inline redlines). Highlights: 

- Scope confirmed: connectors, schema mapping, 2 knowledge-transfer sessions
- Data handling: default 30-day KV cache retention; option to extend to 90 days for an additional fee (see attached fee schedule)
- Capacity: 75k tokens/day for 90 days starting on execution date; usage billed prorated monthly per attached schedule
- Liability and training: explicit "no training" clause added — Redwood will not use Customer Content to train models without written consent
- Execution: we propose DocuSign flow (link below). Please confirm if procurement needs any additional corporate info (W-9, PO number).

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/BRIGHT-0457
Attachments: BrightCart_SOW_Addendum_Redwood_v1.pdf, proposed_fee_schedule.xlsx
